audit.title: Comprehensive Test Suite Overhaul - Coverage, Edge Cases, Mocks, Assertions, AAA Pattern

aaa_pattern_compliance.notes: Most tests follow AAA pattern; 7 tests have mixed concerns

mock_quality.notes: Mocks properly configured; missing verification in 3 cases

assertion_clarity.notes: Assertions mostly clear; 4 use weak matchers

edge_case_coverage.notes: Critical gaps in error scenarios, encoding, concurrency edge cases

test_isolation.notes: Excellent cleanup, proper setup/teardown, no test interdependencies

type_safety.notes: Full TypeScript compliance, proper typing throughout

files.name: async-route.test.ts

deficiencies.title: Missing handler status code tests
deficiencies.description: No tests for handlers returning non-200 status codes (201, 204, 3xx, etc.)
deficiencies.fix: Add 3 tests for different status codes

deficiencies.title: Generic object matching in logger calls
deficiencies.description: expect.objectContaining only checks one field, misses context composition
deficiencies.impact: Missing context fields could go undetected
deficiencies.example: Should verify method, correlationId also in context

deficiencies.title: Unreliable timing assertions
deficiencies.description: Duration range 5ms-5000ms too wide for deterministic test
deficiencies.impact: Timing test could fail on slow systems

deficiencies.title: Factory functions not fully tested
deficiencies.description: asyncPut, asyncPatch, asyncDelete exported but untested
deficiencies.fix: Add 3 tests for missing factory functions

recommendations: Priority 1: Add status code preservation test
Priority 2: Strengthen context assertion with all fields
Priority 3: Use toMatch for correlation ID format

files.name: atomic-file-ops.test.ts
strengths: Excellent setup/teardown with unique temp dirs

deficiencies.title: File-lock implementation not mocked or verified
deficiencies.description: Test assumes withFileLock perfectly serializes, but doesn't verify
deficiencies.impact: Test could be flaky if lock implementation has issues
deficiencies.fix: Mock withFileLock and verify it's called correctly

deficiencies.title: Loose consistency bounds
deficiencies.description: Checks version is 0-10, doesn't verify exact atomicity
deficiencies.impact: Doesn't guarantee true atomicity, only sanity checks
deficiencies.fix: Verify exact operation count matches final version

deficiencies.title: No real error scenarios
deficiencies.description: Missing: disk space, permissions, large files, symlinks

missing_edge_cases: File changes between read and write
recommendations: Priority 1: Mock and verify withFileLock calls
Priority 2: Add real error scenarios (5 tests)

files.name: csrf-protection.test.ts
strengths: Method coverage (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH)

deficiencies.title: No timing-safe comparison test
deficiencies.description: crypto.timingSafeEqual called in implementation but never tested
deficiencies.fix: Add test verifying timing-safe buffer comparison

deficiencies.title: Body token parsing not tested
deficiencies.description: validateCsrfMiddleware accepts _csrf from body, but no test covers this
deficiencies.fix: Add test with { _csrf: 'token' } in request body

deficiencies.title: Unicode and encoding edge cases
deficiencies.description: No tests for null bytes, high unicode, empty tokens, very long tokens

recommendations: Priority 1 (Critical): Add body token parsing test
Priority 2: Add encoding edge case tests

files.name: error-handler.test.ts

deficiencies.title: withErrorLogging function completely untested
deficiencies.description: Major exported function (line 85-151) has zero test coverage
deficiencies.impact: Key API wrapper function not tested

deficiencies.title: Response JSON body never parsed/verified
deficiencies.description: Tests check response exists but don't validate JSON structure
deficiencies.fix: Parse response.json() and assert all required fields

deficiencies.title: Operation mock never verified as called
deficiencies.description: Verifies result but not that operation() was invoked

deficiencies.title: Context tests don't test actual behavior
deficiencies.description: Tests verify mock behavior, not error handler logic
deficiencies.fix: Refactor to test error handler with real logger

recommendations: Priority 1 (Critical): Add response JSON parsing to all tests
Priority 2: Verify mock invocation in operation tests
Priority 3: Refactor context tests to test actual behavior

critical_findings.issue: Timing-safe CSRF token comparison not tested
critical_findings.risk: Timing attacks could bypass CSRF protection
Major API wrapper has zero test coverage
Non-200 responses may be modified by wrapper
